name: Bold Signal
tagline: One vivid orange card on a dark gradient, with big section numbers and breadcrumb navigation. Adapted from the Bold Signal preset in frontend-slides.

palette.description: near-black diagonal gradient, one vivid orange card per slide as the focal point, white type on dark and near-black type on orange

typography.style: heavy single-weight grotesque display in sentence case with tight tracking, paired with a geometric sans for body and wide-tracked uppercase labels

best_for: Decks that need to land a few points hard: product launches, sales kickoffs, founder pitches, all-hands updates and results reviews. Strong for big-number stats, section-by-section stories and before/after comparisons.
avoid_for: Quiet, academic or traditional settings, and long reading documents with many paragraphs. The orange card and heavy display face make every slide loud.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
